body: Q: Is there such athing as spiritual progress? A: As long as there is any trace of ignorance left, there certainly is. But when every trace of ignorance has been destroyed, progress comes to an end. Progress itself is part of the illusion, even though it seems real. "Something has happened. I'm changing. I’m going somewhere, something is happening to me." Finally one realizes that nothing happened, ever. You realize that all the drama of life was only adream.
